name: Create AI unboxing videos from Etsy product photos with Kling 3.0, OpenAI and SocialRobot

parameters.content:
## Turn product photos into an AI unboxing video

For Etsy sellers, makers and small online shops: upload a real photo of your product and, if you have one, a photo of the closed package as you ship it. Kling 3.0 makes a 10-second vertical video that opens the package and ends on your real product photo. SocialRobot posts it publicly to your TikTok profile with TikTok's AI-generated label. TikTok is the only network on by default: the Instagram Reel, Facebook Reel, Threads and Pinterest video pin nodes are disabled until you enable them. To review videos in the TikTok app first, set Post Mode to *Send to Inbox (Draft)*.

### How it works
1. **Form Submission Trigger** takes the product photo, an optional packaging photo, up to 3 extra angles and the facts: name, materials, what ships, price, shop and listing link.
2. The photos go to fal storage. The packaging and product photos are center-cropped to 9:16.
3. Optional: OpenAI looks at the photos and writes 3 shot prompts and the captions, using only the facts you typed.
4. One Kling 3.0 Standard job renders the clip: packaging photo first, product photo last, extra angles as a reference. No packaging photo means a product reveal with no packaging shown.
5. The workflow polls fal, stops after 30 min and cancels the job on timeout. File size and the real MP4 duration are checked.
6. SocialRobot posts the video to TikTok (Direct Post, public, AI label on). Any failure stops with one readable message.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node `@socialrobot-io/n8n-nodes-socialrobot` (3.1.2+) and add your SocialRobot API key
- [ ] Connect TikTok in SocialRobot and pick the account in **Publish TikTok Unboxing Video**. Privacy Level is Public: set it to Private (Only Me) for your first test run
- [ ] Add your fal API key as a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Key YOUR_FAL_KEY`. Select it in every fal HTTP node
- [ ] Add an OpenAI credential to **OpenAI Luna AI Model**, or set `use_openai` to false
- [ ] Review **Set Video Configuration**

n8n Cloud: works on Cloud and self-hosted. No ffmpeg, no Execute Command node, no local files.

Community node: SocialRobot (`@socialrobot-io/n8n-nodes-socialrobot`) is a community node. It isn't maintained by n8n; install it at your own risk.

### Customization
- `video_seconds` (3-15), `shot_count` (1-3), `generate_audio`.
- The unboxing and reveal shot prompts, `prompt_guardrails`, `negative_prompt`.
- `end_on_product_photo`, `use_reference_photos`, `max_reference_photos`.
- `caption_language`, `caption_tone`, `extra_hashtags`, `ai_label_line`, `business_footer`.

### Cost per run (fal list prices, 23 Oct 2026)
| Kling 3.0 Standard | Audio off (default) | Audio on |
|---|---|---|
| 5 s | $0.42 | $0.63 |
| 10 s (default) | **$0.84** | $1.26 |
| 15 s | $1.26 | $1.89 |

Kling 4.0 is $0.16/s ($1.57 for 10 s). fal storage and the crop utility are listed at $0. OpenAI adds about a cent or two.

## 1. Collect the product
**Form Submission Trigger** is the form. **Set Video Configuration** holds every value you'd want to change, including the model id and prices. **Check Product Photo Presence** makes sure a product photo was uploaded.

## 2. Read the photos
**Prepare Product Images** sorts the uploads into packaging, product and extra angles. **Plan Photo Crops** reads each size and plans the 9:16 crops.

## 3. Host the photos on fal
**Post Upload URL Request** asks fal storage for one upload URL per photo, **Attach Photos to URLs** puts each photo next to its URL, and **Upload Photos to Storage** uploads them.

## 4. Crop and check
**Post Crop Image Request** makes the 9:16 frames on fal (extra angles stay whole). **Verify Photos on Storage** catches upload problems and picks unboxing or product reveal. **Route by Video Plan** picks OpenAI or the template prompts.

## 5. Shots and captions (optional OpenAI)
**Generate Unboxing Content** sees the product and packaging photos and writes the shot prompts plus TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads and Pinterest captions. It may only use the facts from the form. **Format Unboxing Content** keeps the answer in shape. If OpenAI fails, the template shots and captions take over.

## 6. Queue the Kling video
**Prepare Kling Request** builds one request: packaging photo as the first frame, product photo as the last frame, extra angles as `@Element1`, guardrails on every shot. It adds the AI label to every caption. **Submit Job to Kling** queues it on fal, **Verify Video Job Queue** checks fal accepted it and **Check Video Queued Status** starts polling.

## 7. Wait for the render
**Wait for Video Status** and **Fetch Video Job Status** check fal every 15 s. **Evaluate Job Status** marks the job done, failed or timed out (30 min) and **Route by Job Status** sends it on. Timeouts cancel the fal job.

## 8. Fetch and check the video
**Fetch Video Result** gets the clip and **Download Unboxing Video** downloads it. **Validate Video Specs** reads the real MP4 duration and size (100 MB cap, Etsy's listing-video limit), and **Check Video Quality** only lets a good file through.

## 9. Post to TikTok
**Publish TikTok Unboxing Video** uses *Direct Post*: Public, AI label on. To test, set Privacy Level to Private. To review in the TikTok app first, use *Send to Inbox (Draft)*. **Compose Video Summary** has the cost, the fal link for Etsy and next steps.

## Optional posts (disabled)
Connected and **disabled by default**. Enable a node and pick an account; it publishes when the run finishes.
- **Submit Instagram Video**: Reel with Instagram's AI label on
- **Post Facebook Reel**: Facebook Reel
- **Publish Threads Clip**: Threads video, caption kept under 500 characters
- **Pin Video on Pinterest**: video pin with a link to your listing and your product photo as the cover. The node has no Pinterest link or cover fields, so this calls the SocialRobot API. Add a Header Auth credential (`x-api-key` = your SocialRobot API key) and set `pinterest_account_id` and `pinterest_board_id`.

## Handle errors
A missing photo, unreadable or tiny photos, upload or crop problems, a rejected or failed Kling job, timeouts, download errors, files that fail the checks and SocialRobot errors all end in **Log Unboxing Errors** with one readable message, then **Halt on Video Error**. **Cancel Video Job Request** cancels the fal job first when it timed out. Add an error workflow in the settings for alerts.

## Switching to Kling 4.0 later
The model id lives in one place: `video_model` in **Set Video Configuration**. fal lists `fal-ai/kling-video/v4/image-to-video` at $0.157/s ($1.57 for 10 s). To switch, change `video_model` and `price_per_second_usd`, then test one run. **Prepare Kling Request** keeps the first and last frame and sends integer shot durations for v4. Kling 4.0 has no audio, reference-photo or negative-prompt fields, so those are only sent to v3. Check the endpoint's input fields on fal before switching.

## AI label and honest product content
- Kling makes new frames from your real photos. Every caption ends with `ai_label_line` ("AI-generated video made from our real product photos."). **Publish TikTok Unboxing Video** and **Submit Instagram Video** have **AI-Generated Content** on, so TikTok shows "Creator labeled as AI-generated".
- Direct Post goes public with no review step. Test with Privacy Level Private, or set Post Mode to *Send to Inbox (Draft)* to review each video in the TikTok app first (then turn on TikTok's AI-generated label in the app when you post).
- The video must show what a buyer gets. Prompts and the negative prompt rule out extra items, gifts, cards, stickers, invented logos and packaging that isn't in your photos. Without a packaging photo, no packaging is shown at all.
- No people: no hands, fingers or faces. The package opens by itself, so nobody looks like a real customer.
- Captions only use the facts you typed: no invented materials or claims, and no reviews, ratings or testimonials. Don't present it as a customer's unboxing.
- Watch the post next to the real product and package. If anything differs, delete it.

parameters.formTitle: Create an AI unboxing video from your product photos
parameters.formDescription: Upload a real photo of your product and, if you have one, a photo of the closed package exactly as you ship it. Kling turns them into a short vertical video that opens the package and ends on your product. It is posted publicly to your TikTok profile with TikTok's AI-generated label. Captions only use the facts you type here.

values.placeholder: Optional. Only true facts, e.g. stoneware, food-safe glaze, 350 ml
Optional. Only what really ships, e.g. kraft box, tissue paper, care card
Optional, exactly as in your shop, e.g. €32

values.formSubmittedText: Thanks! Your unboxing video is rendering. It is usually posted to your TikTok profile within 5-15 minutes, and TikTok may take a few more minutes to process it.

assignments.name: video_model
assignments.value: fal-ai/kling-video/v3/standard/image-to-video

assignments.name: negative_prompt
assignments.value: people, person, hands, fingers, arms, face, body, extra items, accessories, props, gift, free gift, thank-you card, stickers, ribbon, added packaging, different product, changed colors, changed shape, bigger product, text, letters, logo, brand name, watermark, speech, voice, talking, singing, music, blur, distortion, warped, low quality

assignments.name: prompt_guardrails
assignments.value: Keep the product exactly as photographed: same shape, colors, size, materials and details. No items, accessories, gifts, cards, stickers or packaging that are not in the photos. No people, hands, fingers or faces. No text or logos that are not in the photos. No speech or music.

assignments.name: unboxing_shot_1_prompt
assignments.value: The closed package exactly as photographed rests on the table. Slow, gentle push-in, soft natural daylight, calm and still.

assignments.name: unboxing_shot_2_prompt
assignments.value: The package slowly opens by itself with no hands: the lid or flaps lift gently and only the wrapping seen in the photo unfolds, revealing the {product} inside. Slow, smooth motion.

assignments.name: unboxing_shot_3_prompt
assignments.value: Slow push-in to the {product}, ending on a clean hero shot of the {product} exactly as in the product photo. Soft natural daylight.

assignments.name: reveal_shot_1_prompt
assignments.value: Slow cinematic push-in toward the {product}, soft natural daylight, shallow depth of field, calm background as photographed.

assignments.name: reveal_shot_2_prompt
assignments.value: Extreme close-up slow pan across the materials and details of the {product}, gentle rack focus.

assignments.name: reveal_shot_3_prompt
assignments.value: Slow half orbit around the {product}, ending on a clean hero framing of the {product} exactly as photographed.

assignments.name: caption_language
assignments.value: English

assignments.name: caption_tone
assignments.value: Warm, simple and personal, like a maker talking about their work. Short sentences. No hype or superlatives.

assignments.name: extra_hashtags
assignments.value: #handmade #smallbusiness #unboxing

assignments.name: ai_label_line
assignments.value: AI-generated video made from our real product photos.

parameters.text:
=You plan a short vertical AI unboxing video for a small handmade or Etsy shop, and write its social captions.
Image 1 is the shop's REAL photo of the product. {{ $json.packaging_url ? 'Image 2 is the shop\'s REAL photo of the closed package exactly as they ship it. An image-to-video model (Kling) starts the video on image 2 and ends it on image 1, so the video goes from the closed package to the product.' : 'There is no packaging photo (image 2 repeats image 1). Kling animates image 1, so this is a product reveal, not an unboxing: show NO box, bag, wrapping, tissue paper, card or packaging at all.' }}

Facts from the shop (the ONLY facts you may use in captions):
Product name: {{ $('Form Submission Trigger').first().json['Product Name'] }}
Made of: {{ $('Form Submission Trigger').first().json['Made Of'] || 'not given' }}
What ships in the package: {{ $('Form Submission Trigger').first().json['What Ships in the Package'] || 'not given' }}
Price: {{ $('Form Submission Trigger').first().json['Price'] || 'not given' }}
Shop: {{ $('Form Submission Trigger').first().json['Shop Name'] }}
Listing link: {{ $('Form Submission Trigger').first().json['Listing Link'] || 'not given' }}
Caption language: {{ $('Set Video Configuration').first().json.caption_language }}. Tone: {{ $('Set Video Configuration').first().json.caption_tone }}

Return:
- visible_product: one sentence describing only what you can see of the product in image 1.
- shots: exactly {{ Math.min(3, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number($('Set Video Configuration').first().json.shot_count) || 1))) }} objects, each {"prompt": "..."}, in English, under 300 characters each, for a {{ $('Set Video Configuration').first().json.video_seconds }}-second clip cut into that many shots, in order. {{ $json.packaging_url ? 'Beats: the closed package as photographed with a slow push-in; the package opening slowly by itself (lid or flaps lift, wrapping that is visible in image 2 unfolds); a slow move to the product, ending exactly on image 1. With fewer shots, merge the beats in that order.' : 'Beats: a slow push-in toward the product; a slow close pan across its materials and details; a slow half orbit ending on a clean hero framing of image 1. With fewer shots, merge the beats in that order.' }}
- tiktok_caption: under 300 characters, ending with 3-5 hashtags that include {{ $('Set Video Configuration').first().json.extra_hashtags }}.
- instagram_caption: under 600 characters, short lines, hashtags at the end (include {{ $('Set Video Configuration').first().json.extra_hashtags }}).
- facebook_caption: under 500 characters, at most 2 hashtags.
- threads_caption: under 350 characters, at most 1 hashtag.
- pinterest_title: under 90 characters, the product name and the shop, no hashtags.
- pinterest_description: under 500 characters, plain and searchable, at most 3 hashtags.

Rules for the shots:
- Keep the product exactly as photographed: same shape, colors, size, materials, finish and details. Never add, remove, enlarge or restyle anything.
- Show no extra items: no accessories, props, gifts, freebies, samples, thank-you cards, stickers, ribbons, tissue paper or other packaging unless it is clearly visible in the photos.
- No invented branding: no logos, labels, brand names, text or printing that is not in the photos.
- No people at all: no hands, fingers, arms, faces or bodies. Nothing is lifted, held, opened or touched by a person; the package opens slowly by itself.
- Realistic soft daylight, a calm background like the one in the photos, slow smooth camera moves, no fast cuts, no fisheye. No speech, voices or music.

Rules for the captions:
- Use only the facts above. Do not invent materials, sizes, colors, origin, 'handmade', 'eco-friendly', 'plastic-free', 'gift-ready', free gifts, shipping times, stock levels, discounts or prices.
- Mention packaging only as written in 'What ships in the package'.
{{ $json.packaging_url ? '' : '- This video is a product reveal, not an unboxing: do not use #unboxing and do not call it an unboxing.\n' }}- Write the price exactly as given, or leave it out if not given.
- No reviews, ratings, star counts, quotes, testimonials or claims about what customers say or feel. Do not present the video as a customer's unboxing, reaction or review. No superlatives like 'best gift ever'.
- Do not say the video was filmed. Do not write an AI disclosure or disclaimer: one is added automatically.

assignments.name: etsy_note
assignments.value: Etsy listing videos can be 5-15 s and up to 100 MB and play without sound. Download fal_video_url soon if you want to add it to your listing yourself.

assignments.name: next_step
assignments.value: In a few minutes, check the post on your TikTok profile next to the real product and package, and delete it if anything differs. To test first, change Privacy Level in Publish TikTok Unboxing Video to Private. To review each video in the TikTok app before it goes live, set Post Mode to Send to Inbox (Draft).
